Another option (Looks cooler from my point of view, also more informative. After X11 display server protocol.):
`bitcoin-qt` can run on `wayland` communication protocol.
Also, shouldn't X11 be `X11` instead?. Should i add this too?

events.body:
> That holds for builds against distro Qt packages, but `doc/INSTALL_linux.md` is shipped as `INSTALL.md` in the Linux release packages, and the `wayland` plugin is not compiled into those binaries, only `xcb` is available. So the current sentence is accurate for its audience.

Makes sense, thanks for clarifying. My comment was in relation to `depends` changing in the future but until that happens I'm happy to keep things as they are.
